findings: l.1541 (first bullet): the claim needs less than the proof says. The union is globally hyperbolic as soon as it is covered by images of BTZ-embeddings of globally hyperbolic manifolds; no member need contain both p and q, since the image of such an embedding is a future set (GX.Ppcm.mem_range_of_le). Proved as GX.BTZMax.globallyHyperbolic_of_iCover.

l.1536: « the BTZ-extensions of M all have the same cardinality » is not needed. A point of an extension is determined by its germ comap ι (𝓝 x), a filter on M: the extension is Hausdorff and ι(M) is dense. So every union is built inside Filter M, in Type 0.

l.1536: the paper takes an inductive limit over all BTZ-extensions, right filtered by prop:ppcm. Here, Zorn on chains (exists_isMaximal_of_uniqueMorphisms) gives the existence. Prop:ppcm then gives the universality of the maximal extension, and from it the uniqueness (isUniversal_of_isMaximal). The conclusion is the same: it is the colimit.

l.1544-1546 (second bullet) is not formalized: Richards' classification is not in mathlib, and neither is the second countability of a BTZ line through its (R,R)-structure. Its consequence is carried as RichardsInput. Given that input, the step from it to the union being second countable is proved (secondCountable_carrier): countably many members cover S0, and one member covers the rest.

l.1529-1532 vs l.1269-1271: btzthm:maximal_btz_extension says « unique up to isomorphism » where btzthm:BTZ_ext says « up to equivalence ». The Lean proves the stronger one, equivalence over M, which implies the other.
questions: « maximal among such extensions » is not defined. I read it as Causal.AbstractDev.IsMaximal (every extension of E maps back into E). btz_ext also proves the two stronger readings, inextensible and universal, so existence does not depend on the choice. Uniqueness is proved for every E' maximal in the weakest sense.
The paper's E_{>=0}-manifolds are not required to be connected (l.261). M connected is added, as for btzprop:ppcm. Is the theorem meant for connected M, or componentwise?

questions: The introduction's statement repeats l.1529-1532 word for word; it is anchored on the same GX.BTZMax.btz_ext.

kb_proposals: The union of a chain of BTZ-extensions of M lives in Type 0 as a set of germs comap ι (𝓝 x) : Filter M (GX.BTZMax.Carrier). It is injective because the extension is Hausdorff and ι(M) is dense, and it is preserved by embeddings over M, so no cardinality bound and no Shrink are needed.

GX.BTZMax.globallyHyperbolic_of_iCover: an E0-manifold covered by the images of any family of BTZ-embeddings of globally hyperbolic manifolds is globally hyperbolic. No directedness is needed. It generalizes GX.Ppcm.globallyHyperbolic_of_cover.

A union of a chain of open embeddings with the final topology, plus Causal.CBG.gluedChartedSpace over the members, is an E0-manifold (GX.BTZMax.unionCS, trans_inj). Reuse it for any colimit of BTZ-extensions.
With Zorn, a maximal GH BTZ-extension is universal through GX.Ppcm.btz_ppcm and inextensibility (GX.BTZMax.isUniversal_of_isMaximal). The paper's « right filtered » step is that one line.
